# Python Programming Laboratories

Twelve laboratories from the *Script Languages* course at Wrocław University of Science and
Technology, deliberately refactored into **one installable project** instead of twelve loose scripts.
Nine labs read the same Apache access log, so parsing, reading, aggregation and config live once in a
`weblog` package and each lab is a thin script over it — the organising move recorded on
[[extract-the-shared-core]].

75 files, Python ≥3.10, setuptools with a `src/` layout, MIT, remote over SSH.

## Shape

- `src/weblog/` — `entry`, `reader`, `stats`, `config`, `cli`. Declares `dependencies = []`.
- `tests/` — 6 [[pytest]] files, 75 `def test_` plus 5 `parametrize` decorators.
- `labs/01_first_steps/` … `labs/13_sqlite_and_gui/` — each with its own README carrying the
  engineering narrative. See [[numbered-stages-in-directory-names]].
- `data/` (2,039-line access log, a 2.7 MB tweet CSV, a JSON corpus), `assignments/lab-NN.pdf` × 12
  as issued, `assets/` (4 PNGs + a provenance README).
- No `docs/`, no `.gitattributes`, no `CLAUDE.md`, no CI, no Git LFS.

[[pillow]] · [[matplotlib]] · [[sqlite]] · [[tkinter]] · [[setuptools-and-pyproject]].

## Git history — the pure publishing-dump case

The first 12 commits land **all on 2026-07-25**, strictly layer-ordered: `Add the weblog package` →
`Add the test suite` → `Add the data files` → labs in four batches → assignment sheets → screenshots
→ `Add the README, licence and gitignore`. No fix commits, no refactors, no reverts, no message
referring to anything already committed — and **the tests are committed before most of the code they
exercise**.

The 13th, on 2026-08-01, is the first commit in this repository's history that refers to something
already committed. It is a fix, and it is the only one — which is the pattern holding, not breaking:
the publishing dump has no fix commits *because the fixing happened before the import*, and the one
defect that survived the import needed a commit shaped like real work to remove.

The real engineering history survives only as README prose: the Pillow-10 port, the BeautifulSoup
4.13 port, the restructured faculty site, the test that passed for the wrong reason. This repo is the
clean confirmation of [[import-finished-work-into-git]], and the mirror image of
[[discrete-mathematics-laboratories]], which contradicts it. The licence lands in a separate final
commit exactly as in that repo — [[presentation-polish-tail-commits]].

Because the failure modes are written beside their fixes rather than in commits, the READMEs carry
what git does not: [[document-the-failure-mode-next-to-the-fix]] and
[[provenance-and-limits-stated-inline]].

## Findings

- **Confirmed defect, since fixed.** `tests/test_lab09_insults.py` does `import factory` and uses
  `factory.Faker(...)`, and `pyproject.toml`'s `dev` extra listed only `pytest` and `pytest-cov`, so
  the README's own quick start **failed at collection in a clean virtualenv**. `factory-boy`, `faker`
  and `click` were declared on 2026-08-01 in `385d0fd`, each with the reason inline. The repair found
  a second layer the original finding missed: the same test imports `labs/09_dataset_reports/insults.py`,
  which reaches `click` at module scope, so declaring the two obvious packages still did not collect.
  Measured after the fix — **89 tests collected; a clean `pip install -e .[dev]` runs 88 and skips 1**,
  the skip being `pytest.importorskip("openpyxl")`, which lives in the `labs` extra by design.
  `confidence: high`, both states read directly. Recorded on [[factory-boy-and-faker]] and
  [[documentation-drift]].
- **Namespace hazard.** `labs/04_classes/requests.py` shadows the `requests` package that labs 10 and
  11 import, if that directory ever lands on `sys.path`. `confidence: high`.
- The README says "Twelve laboratories" while the directories number to 13/14 — labs 11–12 and 13–14
  are merged into single directories. Minor drift.
- The core package declares zero dependencies and pushes every library into an optional `labs`
  extra — see [[zero-dependency-no-build-step]].
- Generated outputs are gitignored (`build/`, `*.db`, `*.docx`, `*.xlsx`, `charts/`) as "all
  reproducible from source" — the deliberate opposite of [[generated-audit-artifact]].
